newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery hires Salomon junk-bond gaming analyst.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery hires Salomon junk-bond gaming analyst.

text.p: Montgomery Securities has hired Richard Furst, formerly a junk-bond research analyst at Salomon Brothers Inc, to cover the gaming and lodging sector for its new high-yield department, according to a Montgomery official.

Montgomery plans to hire additional research analysts to cover high-yield issuers in the financial services and the consumer goods sectors. The firm is also considering hiring an analyst to cover specialty retailers as well, the official said.
Furst will report to Ned Zachar, the head of high-yield research at Montgomery, who was hired from Chase Securities at the same time. Both began working at Montgomery on February 27.

Prior to coming to Montgomery, Furst worked at Salomon Brothers for 10 years, serving in various positions having to do with the gaming and lodging sector. Before serving as an analyst, he worked in the firm's trading, capital markets and mergers and acquisitions departments.
A Salomon Brothers spokeswoman confirmed that Furst had left but declined further comment.
